name: summernote-bricks
description: Composable Summernote plugin toolbar for semantic bricks.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.heading:build: vite build --config packages/heading/vite.config.ts && tsc -p packages/heading/tsconfig.build.json && node packages/heading/scripts/create-browser-alias.mjs
scripts.heading:cutover-check: npm run heading:build && node scripts/validate-heading-cutover.mjs && node scripts/validate-heading-tarball.mjs
scripts.gallery:build: vite build --config packages/gallery/vite.config.ts && tsc -p packages/gallery/tsconfig.build.json && node packages/gallery/scripts/create-browser-alias.mjs
scripts.gallery:cutover-check: npm run gallery:build && node scripts/validate-gallery-cutover.mjs && node scripts/validate-gallery-tarball.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run pack:check && npm run heading:cutover-check && npm run gallery:cutover-check

author: Eissa Soubhi <eissa.soubhi@gmail.com>
